newsitem.title: USA: Morrison Health sees 10 to 15 pct EPS growth.
newsitem.headline: Morrison Health sees 10 to 15 pct EPS growth.

text.p: Morrison Health Care Inc said it expects to grow its earnings between 10 and 15 percent annually beginning in fiscal 1998, despite pricing pressure that will impact its operating margins.

The pricing pressure would come in fiscal 1998 because of trends in the health care industry, the company said, adding that its "strengthened sales effort and cost reduction focus" would help it grow its earnings.
The company did not provide further details. Officials there were not immediately available.
The company also said it would have revenues and earnings growth "as expected" for the balance of fiscal 1997.
The company, which specializes in health care food and nutrition services, became an independent company in March 1996 after it was spun-off by Morrison Restaurants Inc.
The company reported earnings Thursday for the second quarter ended November 30 of $0.23 per share compared with $0.22 per share in the year-ago period.
